Mission Local reported on a proposal for residential parking permits in streets near Dolores Park—not on converting the park itself into a paid parking lot. Its 2011 post said a City Hall hearing would consider two-hour permit-parking restrictions on nearby sections of 20th and Dolores streets. I found no Mission Local report describing the city turning Dolores Park into a paid parking lot.
